whenToUse: Agent run logs and tool call lists, one short line of status text per step
Labeled dividers that split a transcript or run log into named phases
Ruled summaries such as changed files, and rows that open a link or run an action

whenNotToUse.when: A plain horizontal or vertical rule between content sections or menu items
A complete run console with approval steps, log views or an outcome report
Dated events or milestones joined by indicator dots and a connecting line

agentNotes: Make a row a link or button with `render` on the base twin and `asChild` on the radix twin
`MarkerIcon` is `aria-hidden` with everything inside it, so the `MarkerContent` text alone must say what the row means
An svg in `MarkerIcon` takes each style's icon size only while it carries no size class of its own
